name: BACH_0247_FSIM_jpeg3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (85%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Severity-3 JPEG artifacts flag reliability [F6]; 90% conformal set spans Normal and Benign [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 85%, Benign 11%, InSitu 3%, Invasive 0% | Favors Normal; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot separate Normal and Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability (flagged); 100th OOD percentile | Suspect, out-of-distribution degraded input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (79%–82% similarity) [F5] | Nearest neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 2, 6, 7) · context · Score 1.28 (-0.74), descriptive only [F2] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 8, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.03 (-0.58), unreliable 0/20 check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 10) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.40 (-0.55), opposes invasion [F4] · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting 3 top-risk regions drops risk beyond random (+0.011, CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); relies on unreliable normal lobules, mitoses (0/20 checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation (30% reliability; error AUROC 70%, ECE 5%) masks Benign or InSitu.
- Tissue matches InSitu contrast BACH_0043 (76% similar; invasion, lymphocytes differ) or medial margin (97%) [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 10, 8**: Inspect top-risk regions (40%, 18%, 12%) and 97% medial margin; defer margin.
2. **Regions 3, 5**: Exclude stromal invasion (region 3) and duct-confined atypia (region 5).
3. **Regions 8, 9, 11**: Confirm two-layered lobules directly; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
